WITH counts AS (
  SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN party = 'Democrat' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS democrats,
         SUM(CASE WHEN party = 'Republican' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS republicans
  FROM congress
  WHERE state = 'Indiana'
), dem_zips AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT zc.zip_code
  FROM zip_congress zc
  JOIN congress c ON c.cognress_rep_id = zc.district
  WHERE c.state = 'Indiana' AND c.party = 'Democrat'
)
SELECT 100.0 * democrats / NULLIF(republicans, 0) AS percentage_ratio,
       (SELECT group_concat(zip_code, ', ')
        FROM (SELECT zip_code FROM dem_zips ORDER BY zip_code)) AS zip_codes
FROM counts;
